scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @struchkai/desktop && npm run dev -w @struchkai/desktop
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @struchkai/api && npm run start -w @struchkai/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @struchkai/worker && npm run start -w @struchkai/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @struchkai/domain -w @struchkai/playback -w @struchkai/desktop -w @struchkai/frontend -w @struchkai/api -w @struchkai/worker -w @struchkai/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tests
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @struchkai/api && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/contracts/*.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build -w @struchkai/frontend && npm run build -w @struchkai/desktop && npm run smoke -w @struchkai/desktop
scripts.db:check: npm run build:shared && npm run db:check -w @struchkai/database
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @struchkai/database
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w @struchkai/database
